Schema.Comment: The schema version table stores the current version of the database schema. Implementations are expected to query this table on connecting to the database in order to ensure that the calling code is compatible with the tables in the database.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE schema_version ( sv_lock TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'X', sv_application_id TEXT NOT NULL, sv_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT sv_check_lock_primary PRIMARY KEY (sv_lock),
CONSTRAINT sv_check_lock_locked CHECK (sv_lock = 'X'),
CONSTRAINT sv_version_range CHECK ((sv_version >= 0) AND (sv_version <= 2147483647))
) STRICT

Schema.Comment: The instruments table stores set of loaded instrument instances.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE instruments ( instrument_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, instrument_group TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_name TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_version_major INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_version_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_version_patch INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_qualifier TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT instrument_instance_id_valid CHECK (instrument_instance_id REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
CONSTRAINT instrument_group_valid CHECK (instrument_group REGEXP '^([a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63})(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}){0,15}$'),
CONSTRAINT instrument_name_valid CHECK (instrument_name REGEXP '^([a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63})(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}){0,15}$')
CONSTRAINT instrument_version_major_range CHECK ((instrument_version_major >= 0) AND (instrument_version_major <= 4294967295)),
CONSTRAINT instrument_version_minor_range CHECK ((instrument_version_minor >= 0) AND (instrument_version_minor <= 4294967295)),
CONSTRAINT instrument_version_patch_range CHECK ((instrument_version_patch >= 0) AND (instrument_version_patch <= 4294967295))
) STRICT
Schema.Comment: The ports table stores set of ports on the ensemble and all loaded instrument instances.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE ports ( port_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, port_category TEXT NOT NULL, port_instrument_instance TEXT, port_kind TEXT NOT NULL, port_direction TEXT NOT NULL, port_number INTEGER NOT NULL, port_label TEXT NOT NULL, port_semantics TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT port_id_valid CHECK (port_id REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
CONSTRAINT port_category_valid CHECK ( (port_category = 'AR_ENSEMBLE') OR (port_category = 'AR_INSTRUMENT') ),
CONSTRAINT port_kind_valid CHECK ( (port_kind = 'AR_AUDIO') OR (port_kind = 'AR_NOTE') ),
CONSTRAINT port_direction_valid CHECK ( (port_direction = 'AR_SOURCE') OR (port_direction = 'AR_TARGET') ),
CONSTRAINT port_instrument_instance_exists FOREIGN KEY (port_instrument_instance) REFERENCES instruments (instrument_instance_id),
CONSTRAINT port_number_valid CHECK ((port_number >= 0) AND (port_number <= 4294967295)),
CONSTRAINT port_unique UNIQUE (port_instrument_instance, port_number),
CONSTRAINT port_instrument_valid CHECK ( (port_instrument_instance IS NULL) OR (port_instrument_instance REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') ),
CONSTRAINT port_category_invariant CHECK ( CASE port_category WHEN 'AR_INSTRUMENT' THEN (port_instrument_instance IS NOT NULL) WHEN 'AR_ENSEMBLE' THEN (port_instrument_instance IS NULL) ELSE 0 END )
) STRICT
Schema.Comment: The port_connections table stores set of connections between ports.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE port_connections ( port_connection_source TEXT NOT NULL, port_connection_target TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT port_connection_key PRIMARY KEY (port_connection_source, port_connection_target),
CONSTRAINT port_connection_source_exists FOREIGN KEY (port_connection_source) REFERENCES ports (port_id),
CONSTRAINT port_connection_target_exists FOREIGN KEY (port_connection_target) REFERENCES ports (port_id),
CONSTRAINT port_connection_no_self CHECK (NOT (port_connection_source = port_connection_target)),
CONSTRAINT port_connection_single_target UNIQUE (port_connection_target)
) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER port_connections_check_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON port_connections BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ports.port_direction FROM ports WHERE ports.port_id = NEW.port_connection_source) = ('AR_SOURCE') THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'Source port must have AR_SOURCE direction.') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER port_connections_check_source_update BEFORE UPDATE ON port_connections BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ports.port_direction FROM ports WHERE ports.port_id = NEW.port_connection_source) = ('AR_SOURCE') THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'Source port must have AR_SOURCE direction.') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER port_connections_check_target_insert BEFORE INSERT ON port_connections BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ports.port_direction FROM ports WHERE ports.port_id = NEW.port_connection_target) = ('AR_TARGET') THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'Target port must have AR_TARGET direction.') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER port_connections_check_target_update BEFORE UPDATE ON port_connections BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT ports.port_direction FROM ports WHERE ports.port_id = NEW.port_connection_target) = ('AR_TARGET') THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'Target port must have AR_TARGET direction.') END; END;
Schema.Comment: The undo table stores the undo history.
Schema.Statement: CREATE TABLE undo ( undo_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, undo_description TEXT NOT NULL, undo_time INTEGER NOT NULL, undo_data BLOB NOT NULL ) STRICT
Schema.Comment: The redo table stores the redo history.
Schema.Statement: CREATE TABLE redo ( redo_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, redo_description TEXT NOT NULL, redo_time INTEGER NOT NULL, redo_data BLOB NOT NULL ) STRICT
